bonuses.name: Architect of Ruin
bonuses.text: The GM gains 1 point of Ruin at the start of each of this Threat's turns.

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions.

abilities.name: Terrifying
abilities.text: Anyone that can see this Threat must make a DN 5 Terror Test.

abilities.name: Hideous Mutations
abilities.text: Roll 1d3 on the table below at the start of each of the Chaos Spawn's turns to determine the nature of its constantly shifting mutations. 1: Razor Claw: 12 +3 ED / AP –4 / Range 1. 2: Grasping Tendrils: 12 +3 ED / AP –2 / Range 4 (melee). 3: Dripping Poison: 12 +3 ED / AP –2 / Inflict (Poison 7) / Range 1.

options.name: Winged Spawn
options.text: Some Chaos Spawn manifest wings; these can endure for the Spawn's entire cursed existence, break after their first use, or mutate into something else entirely. Wings: This Threat may clumsily Fly at Speed 10; Athletics (S) Tests may be required for manoeuvring.

options.name: Psychic Spawn
options.text: Warp energy spills uncontrollably from some Chaos Spawn. On a Psychic Spawn's turn, you may roll on any of the tables on p.263 to attempt to trigger a psychic power. The Psychic Spawn has a Psychic Mastery Skill of 6, and always casts at the Transcendent Power Level.
